description: Flutter mobile — add image management and document upload screens to the seller dashboard. ApiClient.uploadImages already exists. Needs image_picker (for gallery/camera) and file_picker (for PDF selection) added to pubspec.yaml, new API client methods for document upload and image deletion, and two new bottom-sheet widgets integrated into the existing SellerDashboard popup menu. Independent of FEAT-002 (web frontend).
steps:
1. Update /var/www/html/property-app/pubspec.yaml — add two dependencies under the dependencies section:
  image_picker: ^1.1.2
  file_picker: ^8.1.7
  Both are standard Flutter packages with no known conflicts with existing dependencies.

2. Add two new methods to ApiClient in /var/www/html/property-app/lib/services/api_client.dart:
  a) `static Future<void> deleteImage(String propertyId, String imageUrl) async { ... }` — sends HTTP DELETE to `$kApiBase/properties/$propertyId/images` with JSON body `{ 'imageUrl': imageUrl }`. Use `http.Request` with method DELETE and json body. Parse response with _parse.
  b) `static Future<dynamic> uploadDocument(String propertyId, String filePath, String fileName, String documentType) async { ... }` — multipart POST to `$kApiBase/properties/$propertyId/documents`. Field `documentType` as a form field, file attached as `document`. Follow the same pattern as uploadImages: get token, create MultipartRequest, add file and field, send and parse response.
  c) `static Future<dynamic> fetchDocuments(String propertyId) async { ... }` — GET `/properties/$propertyId/documents` authenticated. Returns dynamic (List).

3. Add service methods to /var/www/html/property-app/lib/services/property_service.dart:
  a) `static Future<void> deletePropertyImage(String propertyId, String imageUrl) => ApiClient.deleteImage(propertyId, imageUrl);`
  b) `static Future<List<Map<String, dynamic>>> fetchPropertyDocuments(String propertyId) async { final data = await ApiClient.fetchDocuments(propertyId) as List; return data.map((e) => e as Map<String, dynamic>).toList(); }`
  c) `static Future<void> uploadPropertyDocument(String propertyId, String filePath, String fileName, String documentType) => ApiClient.uploadDocument(propertyId, filePath, fileName, documentType);`

4. Create /var/www/html/property-app/lib/screens/seller/manage_images_sheet.dart. This is a StatefulWidget used as a modal bottom sheet. Constructor: `ManageImagesSheet({ required this.property })` where `property` is a `Property`. State fields: `_images` (List<String> copy of property.images), `_loading` (bool), `_error` (String?). Build: return a Column with:
  - Drag handle + title 'Manage Photos'
  - GridView.builder showing fullImageUrl for each image. Each cell is a Stack: Image.network thumbnail + positioned red delete IconButton. On delete tap: show confirmation AlertDialog, on confirm call `PropertyService.deletePropertyImage(property.id, imageUrl)` (send relative path stripped of origin prefix using kApiOrigin), update _images state.
  - 'Add Photos' ElevatedButton at the bottom. On tap: use `ImagePicker().pickMultiImage()`, on result call `ApiClient.uploadImages(property.id, files_as_File_list)`, update _images.
  - Error Text widget if _error != null.
  - CircularProgressIndicator overlay when _loading.
  Import: `import 'package:image_picker/image_picker.dart'; import 'dart:io';`

5. Create /var/www/html/property-app/lib/screens/seller/manage_documents_sheet.dart. StatefulWidget. Constructor: `ManageDocumentsSheet({ required this.propertyId, required this.propertyTitle })`. State: `_docs` (List<Map<String,dynamic>>), `_loading` (bool), `_selectedType` (String = 'OTHER'), `_error` (String?). initState calls `_fetchDocs()`. `_fetchDocs`: sets loading=true, calls `PropertyService.fetchPropertyDocuments(propertyId)`, updates _docs. Build: Column with:
  - Drag handle + title 'Legal Documents'
  - ListView of _docs: each shows a ListTile with leading 📄 icon, title=filename, subtitle=type, trailing=status chip.
  - Row at bottom: DropdownButton for type (KHATAUNI, KHASRA, REGISTRY, OTHER) + 'Upload PDF' ElevatedButton. On tap: `FilePicker.platform.pickFiles(type: FileType.custom, allowedExtensions: ['pdf', 'jpg', 'jpeg', 'png'])`. On result: call `PropertyService.uploadPropertyDocument(propertyId, result.files.first.path!, result.files.first.name, _selectedType)`. Then call `_fetchDocs()`. Show snackbar on success.
  Import: `import 'package:file_picker/file_picker.dart';`
